qas.q: What's the difference between an ottoman bed and a divan bed?
qas.a: An ottoman bed lifts its whole base on gas pistons, so the space under the mattress becomes one big storage area. A divan is a fabric-covered base that can have drawers, an ottoman lift or no storage at all. Ottomans suit bulky items; drawers suit everyday things.
qas.source: GSC: divan vs ottoman (174 imp, pos 18.4), ottoman vs divan (122, 18.7), are ottoman beds better than divan beds (108, 7.7) and variants, about 625 imp in total. Facts: /blogs/news/ottoman-bed-vs-divan-bed-uk

qas.a: A divan bed is a fabric-covered base, usually a wooden platform, that sits close to the floor and takes your mattress. It is normally paired with a headboard and often has built-in drawers or an ottoman gas lift for storage. Divans give a neat, compact look that suits smaller rooms.
qas.source: GSC: what is a divan bed (126 imp, pos 18.5), what is a divan bed base (51, 10.7), what are divan beds (30, 16.1) and variants, about 290 imp. Facts: /blogs/news/divan-bed-vs-bed-frame-uk

qas.q: Is a divan better than a bed frame?
qas.a: It depends on the room. A divan is better for storage, with drawers or an ottoman lift, and feels firm and solid. An upholstered bed frame stands on legs, has a slatted base for airflow and makes a bigger statement. Pick a divan for storage, a frame for style.
qas.source: GSC: divan vs bed frame (190 imp, pos 10.5), platform bed frame vs divan base which is better (152, 7.8), divan bed vs bed frame uk (34, 8.1) and variants, about 440 imp. Facts: /blogs/news/divan-bed-vs-bed-frame-uk

qas.q: How does an ottoman or gas lift bed work?
qas.a: An ottoman bed has gas pistons on each side of the base, like an office chair. You lift the base by its handle, the pistons take the weight of the mattress and hold it open, and you reach all the storage underneath. To close it, guide the base back down.
qas.source: GSC: how do ottoman beds work (128 imp, pos 7.1), how does the lifting mechanism in an ottoman bed work (78, 1.8), how does an ottoman bed work (71, 8.6), what is gas lift storage bed (69, 11.5) and variants, about 750 imp. Facts: /blogs/news/how-do-ottoman-beds-work

qas.a: A Chesterfield bed is inspired by the classic Chesterfield sofa. Its headboard has deep-button tufting, where the fabric is pulled back in a diamond or square pattern to make raised buttons. It gives a traditional look. Eagle Bed handmakes Chesterfield beds in Dewsbury, in sizes from single to super king.
qas.source: GSC: what is a chesterfield bed (122 imp, pos 25.9). Facts: /blogs/news/chesterfield-beds-uk-buying-guide

qas.q: Is a 4ft small double bed good for a spare room?
qas.a: Yes, a small double suits spare rooms well. It takes a 120 by 190 centimetre mattress, which is 30 centimetres wider than a single and 15 narrower than a standard double. It gives one person plenty of room and can take two guests now and then.
qas.source: GSC: best 4ft small double bed with mattress for a spare room (89 imp, pos 10.4), small double bed size (11, 74). Facts: /blogs/news/small-double-beds-uk-the-complete-guide-for-spare-rooms

qas.q: What are the standard UK bed sizes?
qas.a: From smallest to largest, UK mattress sizes are: small single, 75 by 190 centimetres; single, 90 by 190; small double, 120 by 190; double, 135 by 190; king, 150 by 200; and super king, 180 by 200. Eagle Bed makes all six, with the small single in our kids beds.
qas.source: GSC: bed sizes in order (26 imp, pos 25.5), uk bed sizes (21, 67.1), single bed dimensions uk (21, 6.1), bed dimensions (20, 28.2) and about 170 other size queries, about 460 imp. Facts: /pages/bed-sizes-guide

qas.q: How can I tell if a bed is really handmade in a UK workshop?
qas.a: Ask where it is made and check the frame material on the product page. Solid wood is a strong choice, while some cheaper beds use MDF or chipboard. At Eagle Bed, every bed is made to order on a solid wood frame and upholstered by hand in our Dewsbury workshop.
qas.source: GSC: how can i tell if a bed is actually handcrafted in a uk workshop rather than mass-produced? (40 imp, pos 7.6), handmade beds yorkshire (33, 18.4). Facts: /blogs/news/handmade-beds-uk-quality-guide, /pages/about-us

qas.q: How long does Eagle Bed delivery take?
qas.a: Delivery usually takes 3 to 5 working days, because each bed is made to order. It is free across England, Scotland and Wales, and our own team brings it to your door. Once it is dispatched, we contact you to arrange a delivery window and email tracking.
qas.source: Common buyer question (custom bed uk delivery: 32 imp, pos 25.3). Facts: /pages/delivery-information, BRIEF

qas.q: Does Eagle Bed deliver to Leeds, Manchester and London?
qas.a: Yes. Eagle Bed delivers free to Leeds, Manchester and London, and across the rest of England, Scotland and Wales, using our own team. It usually takes 3 to 5 working days. Delivery to Northern Ireland, Jersey, Guernsey and the Isle of Man is £90. Elsewhere, contact us first.
qas.source: Common buyer question (fabric beds manchester: 81 imp, pos 9.6; chesterfield beds manchester: 38, 12.4; bed delivery london: 2, 41). City pages are unpublished, so this goes on the delivery page. Facts: /pages/delivery-information, /pages/bespoke-beds-uk, BRIEF

qas.q: Can I pay for my bed with Klarna?
qas.a: Yes. You can choose Klarna or Clearpay at checkout to spread the cost in instalments, subject to eligibility. You can also pay by card or PayPal. If you would rather pay cash when your bed arrives, call 07417 439197 or email us before you order and we will arrange it.
qas.source: GSC: can i buy a super king mattress on finance or payment plan (14 imp, pos 4.4), clearpay beds (9, 10.3), mattress brands with klarna or clearpay uk (4, 6.3). Facts: /pages/finance-options, BRIEF (card, PayPal)

qas.q: What is Eagle Bed's returns policy?
qas.a: You can return an item free within 14 days, and we collect it, as long as it is unused, unassembled and in its original packaging. If it arrives faulty or damaged, tell us within 14 days for a free replacement or full refund. Opened mattresses cannot be returned unless faulty.

qas.q: Do Eagle Bed beds come with a warranty?
qas.a: Yes. Every Eagle Bed frame and headboard comes with a 5-year limited manufacturer warranty. It covers faults in materials and workmanship under normal home use. It does not cover misuse, accidents, incorrect assembly or normal wear, such as fabric fading. To claim, call 07417 439197 with your order number.

Eagle Bed's workshop is in Dewsbury, West Yorkshire. Every frame is built and upholstered to order there, and we do not import finished beds. You can call the team on 07417 439197, Monday to Friday, 9am to 6pm, or email eaglebedofficial@gmail.com with any questions.
qas.source: GSC: beds dewsbury (15 imp, pos 32.7), beds made in yorkshire (10, 39.4), bed manufacturer dewsbury (3, 19). Facts: /pages/about-us, BRIEF (say Dewsbury only)

qas.q: Can I get my bed made in a custom colour?
qas.a: Yes. Each bed is made to order, so you choose the size, fabric and colour. Fabrics include plush velvet, chenille, Coniston, Naples, Galaxy and Teddy bouclé, in solid colours, stripes or two-tone. Custom fabric and colour are available on request, and we post free fabric swatches to you.

You can return an item free within 14 days, and we collect it, as long as it is unused, unassembled and in its original packaging. If it arrives faulty or damaged, tell us within 14 days for a free replacement or full refund. Opened mattresses cannot be returned unless faulty.

Do Eagle Bed beds come with a warranty?

Yes. Every Eagle Bed frame and headboard comes with a 5-year limited manufacturer warranty. It covers faults in materials and workmanship under normal home use. It does not cover misuse, accidents, incorrect assembly or normal wear, such as fabric fading. To claim, call 07417 439197 with your order number.

Can I get my bed made in a custom colour?

Yes. Each bed is made to order, so you choose the size, fabric and colour. Fabrics include plush velvet, chenille, Coniston, Naples, Galaxy and Teddy bouclé, in solid colours, stripes or two-tone. Custom fabric and colour are available on request, and we post free fabric swatches to you.
